experimental_shadow.definition: Build-only robust-z mean of process and outcome residual scores, active only when their signs agree.
experimental_shadow.reason: Best fixed-screen robustness, but designed after inspecting earlier results and the nested DQ-tweak class was effectively flat. Requires a new season.

market_overlay.definition: Walk-forward HGB predicts 15-minute home-token fair markout from market/game state plus DQ families.
market_overlay.reason: Best nested model class, but direct markout R2 is negative and the fixed model fails the 120-second latency scenario.

recommended_research_core.definition: Walk-forward HGB predicts per-play EPA from pre-play state and CV process features; form a home-signed prediction-minus-realized-EPA residual; EWM span 5. The selected market orientation is -1.
recommended_research_core.reason: Most defensible balance of process interpretation, fixed-screen performance, and latency/fee stability. Its confidence interval still includes zero.

rejected.reason: Negative fixed-window and nested results; P11 features add no measurable 15-minute markout accuracy.

secondary_research_score.definition: Walk-forward HGB predicts EPA using state, CV, and observed outcome fields; home-signed prediction-minus-realized-EPA residual; EWM span 10.
secondary_research_score.reason: Positive fixed-window evidence, but outcome fields dominate and the 120-second latency test is negative.
